# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability privately

Email **[keshav.katwe@gmail.com](mailto:keshav.katwe@gmail.com)** with the subject
`Toolgrain security report`. This reaches the project maintainer, Keshav Katwe.
Use this contact for suspected vulnerabilities in Toolgrain's libraries or
repository automation.

Include the affected package and version, runtime and protocol revision, a
description of the impact, and a minimal reproduction or proof of concept.
Remove credentials, access tokens, personal data, and unrelated private code.
If sensitive material is necessary to reproduce the issue, arrange a suitable
transfer method with the maintainer first.

Keep vulnerability details out of public issues and pull requests while the
report is being investigated. The maintainer will coordinate fixes and
disclosure with the reporter. There is no guaranteed response or resolution
time.

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest stable release. Older releases and prereleases
have no separate backport commitment. The current stable series is **0.1.x**;
see [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@toolgrain/mcp) for the latest version and
the [support policy](../docs/support-policy.md) for supported runtimes and peers.

For ordinary bugs and usage questions, use the repository's
[issue forms](https://github.com/keshavkatwe/toolgrain/issues/new/choose).
